extractedJobs.title: Junior Production Planner
mandatoryRequirements: Tertiary qualification in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field
preferredRequirements: 0–2 years’ experience in a production planning, supply chain, or manufacturing environment
Understanding of food manufacturing principles including shelf life, allergens, batch traceability, and HACCP
Exposure to ERP systems highly desirable
responsibilities: Assist in developing and maintaining daily and weekly production plans to meet customer demand while optimising line efficiency and minimising waste
Monitor raw material and packaging stock levels and coordinate with procurement to ensure timely availability for production runs
Collaborate with production supervisors, quality assurance, and warehouse teams to execute the production schedule and resolve any short-term planning issues
Track production performance (plan vs actual) and report on output, downtime, and material utilisation
Maintain planning master data and scheduling parameters in the ERP system (e.g., SAP)
Support new product launches and promotions by coordinating production timelines and material readiness
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing changeovers, improving planning accuracy, and minimising product write-offs due to shelf life
Prepare and distribute planning reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders
employerQuestions: How many years' experience do you have as a Production Planner?
Do you have experience using Microsoft Excel?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
Tell us how you stay organised when you have a few things to do at once.
otherDetails: Capable of managing multiple tasks under pressure
